title: Aesthetic Measure (gzip)
summary: The browser's own deflate compressor computes Birkhoff's beauty formula M = O / C, and crowns the emptiest canvas.
mechanism: CompressionStream('deflate') squeezes each canvas specimen's raw RGBA bytes; bytes removed are order O, bytes kept are complexity C, the ratio is the live aesthetic measure.
references: Abraham A. Moles, Information Theory and Esthetic Perception (1958)
Claude E. Shannon, A Mathematical Theory of Communication (1948)
